What makes the baseline useful for evalu.en: What makes the baseline useful for evaluating your later work?
What makes the baseline useful for evalu.pt-BR: O que torna a referência útil para avaliar seu trabalho depois?
What makes the baseline useful for evalu.es: ¿Qué hace útil la referencia para evaluar tu trabajo posterior?
What makes the baseline useful for evalu.fr: Qu’est-ce qui rend la référence utile pour évaluer la suite du travail ?
What makes the baseline useful for evalu.de: Was macht den Ausgangswert für die spätere Bewertung nützlich?
What makes the baseline useful for evalu.it: Cosa rende utile il riferimento per valutare il lavoro successivo?

A recorded result with explicit inputs a.en: A recorded result with explicit inputs and criteria.
A recorded result with explicit inputs a.pt-BR: Um resultado registrado com insumos e critérios explícitos.
A recorded result with explicit inputs a.es: Un resultado registrado con insumos y criterios explícitos.
A recorded result with explicit inputs a.fr: Un résultat consigné avec des entrées et critères explicites.
A recorded result with explicit inputs a.de: Ein dokumentiertes Ergebnis mit klaren Eingaben und Kriterien.
A recorded result with explicit inputs a.it: Un risultato registrato con input e criteri espliciti.

A polished result with undocumented assu.en: A polished result with undocumented assumptions.
A polished result with undocumented assu.pt-BR: Um resultado refinado com hipóteses sem registro.
A polished result with undocumented assu.es: Un resultado pulido con supuestos sin documentar.
A polished result with undocumented assu.fr: Un résultat soigné aux hypothèses non documentées.
A polished result with undocumented assu.de: Ein ausgefeiltes Ergebnis mit undokumentierten Annahmen.
A polished result with undocumented assu.it: Un risultato curato con ipotesi non documentate.

A success criterion chosen after seeing.en: A success criterion chosen after seeing the result.
A success criterion chosen after seeing.pt-BR: Um critério escolhido depois de ver o resultado.
A success criterion chosen after seeing.es: Un criterio elegido después de ver el resultado.
A success criterion chosen after seeing.fr: Un critère choisi après avoir vu le résultat.
A success criterion chosen after seeing.de: Ein Kriterium, das erst nach Sichtung des Ergebnisses gewählt wurde.
A success criterion chosen after seeing.it: Un criterio scelto dopo aver visto il risultato.

A baseline with documented inputs and cr.en: A baseline with documented inputs and criteria makes later changes interpretable.
A baseline with documented inputs and cr.pt-BR: Uma referência com insumos e critérios documentados permite interpretar mudanças posteriores.
A baseline with documented inputs and cr.es: Una referencia con insumos y criterios documentados permite interpretar cambios posteriores.
A baseline with documented inputs and cr.fr: Une référence aux entrées et critères documentés permet d’interpréter les changements ultérieurs.
A baseline with documented inputs and cr.de: Ein Ausgangswert mit dokumentierten Eingaben und Kriterien macht spätere Änderungen nachvollziehbar.
A baseline with documented inputs and cr.it: Un riferimento con input e criteri documentati rende interpretabili le modifiche successive.

Which record makes your work reproducibl.en: Which record makes your work reproducible by another learner?
Which record makes your work reproducibl.pt-BR: Qual registro permite que outro aluno reproduza seu trabalho?
Which record makes your work reproducibl.es: ¿Qué registro permite que otro alumno reproduzca tu trabajo?
Which record makes your work reproducibl.fr: Quelle trace permet à un autre apprenant de reproduire ton travail ?
Which record makes your work reproducibl.de: Welche Aufzeichnung hilft anderen Lernenden, deine Arbeit zu reproduzieren?
Which record makes your work reproducibl.it: Quale registrazione permette a un altro studente di riprodurre il tuo lavoro?

The inputs, the steps and the observed o.en: The inputs, the steps and the observed outputs.
The inputs, the steps and the observed o.pt-BR: Os insumos, as etapas e os resultados observados.
The inputs, the steps and the observed o.es: Los insumos, los pasos y los resultados observados.
The inputs, the steps and the observed o.fr: Les entrées, les étapes et les résultats observés.
The inputs, the steps and the observed o.de: Die Eingaben, die Schritte und die beobachteten Ergebnisse.
The inputs, the steps and the observed o.it: Gli input, i passaggi e i risultati osservati.

A description of the final appearance on.en: A description of the final appearance only.
A description of the final appearance on.pt-BR: Apenas uma descrição da aparência final.
A description of the final appearance on.es: Solo una descripción del aspecto final.
A description of the final appearance on.fr: Une simple description de l’apparence finale.
A description of the final appearance on.de: Nur eine Beschreibung des endgültigen Aussehens.

A list of tools with no record of decisi.en: A list of tools with no record of decisions.
A list of tools with no record of decisi.pt-BR: Uma lista de ferramentas sem registro das decisões.
A list of tools with no record of decisi.es: Una lista de herramientas sin registro de decisiones.
A list of tools with no record of decisi.fr: Une liste d’outils sans trace des décisions.
A list of tools with no record of decisi.it: Un elenco di strumenti senza traccia delle decisioni.

Recording inputs, steps and outputs lets.en: Recording inputs, steps and outputs lets another learner reproduce and check the result.
Recording inputs, steps and outputs lets.pt-BR: Registrar insumos, etapas e resultados permite que outro aluno reproduza e confira o resultado.
Recording inputs, steps and outputs lets.es: Registrar insumos, pasos y resultados permite que otro alumno reproduzca y compruebe el resultado.
Recording inputs, steps and outputs lets.fr: Consigner entrées, étapes et résultats permet à autrui de reproduire et de vérifier le résultat.
Recording inputs, steps and outputs lets.de: Dokumentierte Eingaben, Schritte und Ausgaben ermöglichen es anderen Lernenden, das Ergebnis zu reproduzieren und zu prüfen.
Recording inputs, steps and outputs lets.it: Registrare input, passaggi e output consente a un altro studente di riprodurre e verificare il risultato.

What is the strongest check that your re.en: What is the strongest check that your revision addressed the observed weakness?
What is the strongest check that your re.pt-BR: Qual é a melhor verificação de que sua revisão resolveu a fragilidade observada?
What is the strongest check that your re.es: ¿Cuál es la mejor comprobación de que tu revisión resolvió la debilidad observada?
What is the strongest check that your re.fr: Quel test montre le mieux que ta révision a corrigé la faiblesse observée ?
What is the strongest check that your re.de: Welche Prüfung zeigt am besten, dass deine Überarbeitung die beobachtete Schwäche behoben hat?
What is the strongest check that your re.it: Quale prova mostra meglio che la revisione ha risolto il punto debole osservato?

Rerun the failing case and the baseline.en: Rerun the failing case and the baseline with documented expectations.
Rerun the failing case and the baseline.pt-BR: Repita o caso que falhou e a referência com expectativas documentadas.
Rerun the failing case and the baseline.es: Repite el caso fallido y la referencia con expectativas documentadas.
Rerun the failing case and the baseline.fr: Rejoue le cas en échec et la référence avec des attentes documentées.
Rerun the failing case and the baseline.de: Wiederhole den fehlgeschlagenen Fall und den Ausgangstest mit dokumentierten Erwartungen.
Rerun the failing case and the baseline.it: Ripeti il caso fallito e il test di riferimento con aspettative documentate.

Test only a new case that is likely to p.en: Test only a new case that is likely to pass.
Test only a new case that is likely to p.pt-BR: Teste apenas um caso novo com boa chance de passar.
Test only a new case that is likely to p.es: Prueba solo un caso nuevo que probablemente pase.
Test only a new case that is likely to p.fr: Teste seulement un nouveau cas susceptible de réussir.
Test only a new case that is likely to p.de: Teste nur einen neuen Fall, der wahrscheinlich besteht.
Test only a new case that is likely to p.it: Prova solo un nuovo caso che probabilmente passerà.

Replace the original result with the rev.en: Replace the original result with the revised one.
Replace the original result with the rev.pt-BR: Substitua o resultado original pela versão revisada.
Replace the original result with the rev.es: Sustituye el resultado original por la versión revisada.
Replace the original result with the rev.fr: Remplace le résultat initial par sa version révisée.
Replace the original result with the rev.de: Ersetze das ursprüngliche Ergebnis durch die überarbeitete Fassung.
Replace the original result with the rev.it: Sostituisci il risultato originale con quello rivisto.

Repeating the failing case checks the re.en: Repeating the failing case checks the repair, and repeating the baseline checks for regression.
Repeating the failing case checks the re.pt-BR: Repetir o caso que falhou verifica a correção, e repetir a referência ajuda a detectar regressões.
Repeating the failing case checks the re.es: Repetir el caso fallido comprueba la corrección, y repetir la referencia detecta regresiones.
Repeating the failing case checks the re.fr: Rejouer le cas en échec vérifie la correction, et rejouer la référence détecte une régression.
Repeating the failing case checks the re.de: Der erneute Fehlerfall prüft die Korrektur, der erneute Ausgangstest mögliche Rückschritte.
Repeating the failing case checks the re.it: Ripetere il caso fallito verifica la correzione, ripetere il riferimento rileva regressioni.

What is evidence that the method transfe.en: What is evidence that the method transfers to a new situation?
What is evidence that the method transfe.pt-BR: O que demonstra que o método funciona em uma nova situação?
What is evidence that the method transfe.es: ¿Qué demuestra que el método funciona en una situación nueva?
What is evidence that the method transfe.fr: Qu’est-ce qui prouve que la méthode s’applique à une nouvelle situation ?
What is evidence that the method transfe.de: Was belegt, dass die Methode auf eine neue Situation übertragbar ist?
What is evidence that the method transfe.it: Cosa dimostra che il metodo si trasferisce a una nuova situazione?

A changed constraint, a new result and a.en: A changed constraint, a new result and a documented comparison.
A changed constraint, a new result and a.pt-BR: Uma restrição alterada, um resultado novo e uma comparação documentada.
A changed constraint, a new result and a.es: Una restricción cambiada, un resultado nuevo y una comparación documentada.
A changed constraint, a new result and a.fr: Une contrainte modifiée, un nouveau résultat et une comparaison documentée.
A changed constraint, a new result and a.de: Eine geänderte Vorgabe, ein neues Ergebnis und ein dokumentierter Vergleich.
A changed constraint, a new result and a.it: Un vincolo modificato, un nuovo risultato e un confronto documentato.

The same result with a different project.en: The same result with a different project title.
The same result with a different project.pt-BR: O mesmo resultado com outro título de projeto.
The same result with a different project.es: El mismo resultado con otro título de proyecto.
The same result with a different project.fr: Le même résultat avec un autre titre de projet.
The same result with a different project.de: Dasselbe Ergebnis mit einem anderen Projekttitel.
The same result with a different project.it: Lo stesso risultato con un altro titolo del progetto.

A claim of general usefulness without a.en: A claim of general usefulness without a new test.
A claim of general usefulness without a.pt-BR: Uma afirmação de utilidade geral sem um novo teste.
A claim of general usefulness without a.es: Una afirmación de utilidad general sin una nueva prueba.
A claim of general usefulness without a.fr: Une affirmation d’utilité générale sans nouveau test.
A claim of general usefulness without a.de: Eine Behauptung allgemeiner Nützlichkeit ohne neuen Test.
A claim of general usefulness without a.it: Una dichiarazione di utilità generale senza una nuova prova.

Transfer is demonstrated by applying the.en: Transfer is demonstrated by applying the method under a changed constraint and explaining the result.
Transfer is demonstrated by applying the.pt-BR: A transferência se demonstra ao aplicar o método com outra restrição e explicar o resultado.
Transfer is demonstrated by applying the.es: La transferencia se demuestra al aplicar el método con otra restricción y explicar el resultado.
Transfer is demonstrated by applying the.fr: Le transfert se démontre en appliquant la méthode à une contrainte modifiée et en expliquant le résultat.
Transfer is demonstrated by applying the.de: Übertragbarkeit zeigt sich, wenn die Methode mit geänderter Vorgabe angewendet und das Ergebnis erklärt wird.
Transfer is demonstrated by applying the.it: Il trasferimento si dimostra applicando il metodo con un vincolo diverso e spiegando il risultato.
